extraction.notes: 2027 rates and registration listings are posted. Several program-description dates and eligibility ranges conflict with UltraCamp; these are flagged on the affected cards. Browser opens returned no readable text, so additional research relied on official search-indexed pages and the supplied page text. No dated 2027 registration opening announcement was found. The WORX Project has no verified 2027 schedule; its undated registration-page weeks were not assigned a year. Canoeing and climbing appear as themed Pioneers day-camp sessions in UltraCamp, although the rates page lists them as $575 specialty day camps.

excluded.name: Equestrian lessons and guided trail rides
excluded.reason: Year-round lessons and activities, not finite summer camps.

cards.name: Explorers
cards.description: Campers participate in worship, art, canoeing, hiking, swimming and games on Camp Grier's campus.
cards.review_notes: Description-page dates have no explicit year alongside them; interpreted as 2027 from the linked Summer 2027 rates and current navigation.

cards.name: Discoverers
cards.description: Campers spend one night camping away from their cabin on campus and participate in worship, art, canoeing, hiking, swimming and games.
cards.review_notes: Session 5 ends July 15 on the description page but July 16 in UltraCamp; used UltraCamp's explicitly dated 2027 listing.

cards.name: Adventurers
cards.description: Campers use Camp Grier as a base for river paddling or rock climbing and traditional camp activities. Two-week campers take a two-night backpacking trip.
cards.review_notes: UltraCamp lists Session 3 at $1305 rather than $1205, Session 7 grades 10–12 rather than rising 7–9, and Session 6/7 ending July 23 rather than July 30. Used description-page eligibility, Session 3 price and two-week end date. Session 5 ends July 15 on the description page but July 16 in UltraCamp.

cards.name: Navigators
cards.description: Campers participate in traditional camp activities and off-campus river or rock-climbing trips. Two-week campers also backpack for three nights, develop leadership skills and complete service activities.
cards.review_notes: Description-page dates lack an adjacent year; interpreted as 2027 from the current Summer 2027 rates and navigation.

cards.name: Navigator Wilderness Adventures
cards.description: Campers practice hiking, orienteering, canoeing and rock climbing, with one or two nights camping in the woods.
cards.review_notes: The description lists June 21–26, unlike other Session 2 programs' June 20–25. Confirm whether this is a stale date; year is inferred from current 2027 context.

cards.name: Onewheel Camp
cards.description: Campers receive Onewheel instruction and participate in trail riding, trick sessions, challenges and competitions.
cards.review_notes: UltraCamp's Middle School One Wheel listing says grades 6–9; the description page says rising 6–8 and a separate rising 9–12 group. Used description-page bands.

cards.name: Equestrian
cards.description: Campers practice ground horsemanship, arena riding and trail riding, alongside worship, swimming, canoeing and art.
cards.review_notes: Description-page dates lack an adjacent year; interpreted as 2027 from current rates and navigation.

cards.name: Equestrian Day Camp
cards.description: Campers practice ground horsemanship, arena riding and trail riding and participate in other camp activities.
cards.review_notes: Description page says rising grades 5–12 and August 2–6; UltraCamp says grades 4–12 and August 2–5. Used description-page eligibility and Friday end date.

cards.name: Mountain Bike
cards.description: Campers practice riding skills and trail etiquette through instruction and guided rides. They also participate in art, canoeing, swimming and games.
cards.review_notes: Description-page dates lack an adjacent year; interpreted as 2027 from current rates and navigation.

cards.name: Mountain Bike Day Camp
cards.description: Campers receive mountain-bike instruction and practice riding skills and trail etiquette on guided rides.
cards.review_notes: Day-session eligibility is expressed only as Adventurers and Discoverers; grade ranges follow those explicitly defined bands on the same page. Dates interpreted as 2027 from current rates.

cards.name: Eco Camp
cards.description: Campers explore sustainable farming, food systems and environmental science through hands-on activities. They also swim, play field games and use the climbing wall.

cards.name: Leadership & Counselor Training
cards.description: Campers practice communication, problem solving and outdoor leadership. The two-week program includes a multi-day canoeing or backpacking trip.
cards.review_notes: Eligibility is rising 11th grade through rising college freshman; college freshman is not encoded as a numeric K–12 grade. Dates lack an adjacent year and are interpreted from current 2027 rates.

cards.name: Summer Day Camp
cards.description: Campers participate in outdoor adventures, games and classic camp activities, with meals in the dining hall. Pioneers have rock-climbing and canoeing themed sessions.

lunch.text: with meals in the dining hall

cards.review_notes: Additional facts were accessible only through official search snippets. UltraCamp lists Sunday–Friday dates; actual weekday attendance and hours need confirmation. Rates page lists canoe and climbing specialty day camps at $575, while the Pioneers themed listings are $400. The May 29 registration close applies only to Session 1 Pathfinders, not all sessions.

cards.name: The WORX Project
cards.description: Students explore skilled trades and career-connected learning through hands-on outdoor activities.
cards.review_notes: The indexed registration form title says 2026 Week 1 July 7–10, but its body says Week Two July 13–16; used the body dates and title's year. Eligibility is rising grades 6–8 attending Buncombe County or Asheville City public schools, plus ACS IRL rising 9th graders. The official website lists four undated July weeks; their year could not be verified, so only the form-supported week is included. A school-system listing gives Camp Woodson, 55 Woodson Rd, Fairview, NC, but describes traveling there; the parent drop-off site was not established, so sites is empty.
